articles.title: Ronin set to transition to Ethereum layer 2 from independent sidechain
articles.snippet: The purpose behind the migration is to enhance security, tokenomics and scalability, said Ronin, which suffered the largest DeFi bridge exploit on record in 2022.

articles.title: White hat returns $190K to Renegade hours after hacking the protocol
articles.snippet: The white hat hacker said the decision to exploit Renegade’s dark pool was made to protect the funds and safety of DeFi users.

articles.title: Kash Patel Touts AI Overhaul of FBI Crime-Fighting Operations
articles.snippet: FBI Director Kash Patel said the use of AI has accelerated child exploitation investigations, threat detection, and internal operations.

articles.title: Arbitrum DAO Votes to Unlock $70 Million for Kelp DAO Exploit Relief
articles.snippet: Arbitrum DAO voted to release the Kelp exploit funds, but a U.S. Court restraining notice has put the approved transfer in legal jeopardy.
